answer: Forging extra identities requires locking fresh capital per identity, so attack cost scales linearly while honest participants reach their reputation zenith through sustained honest work. Duplicate or low-effort identities get slashed and pruned, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
